title: Utility is in the Eye of the User: A Critique of NLP Leaderboards

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical discussion and critique; the paper does not empirically measure this bias itself, but evaluates how current NLP leaderboards fail to penalize it, referencing prior empirical findings on gender-stereotypical inputs and the use of the Winogender schema.

Theoretical discussion and critique; the paper highlights the limitations of performance-based leaderboards by pointing out their failure to account for racial bias, referencing existing literature on racial stereotypes captured in embedding spaces.
